title: Adoption Identity Persistence and OrgID Migration
observed_behavior_before: Adoption matched existing services by runtime_config.adopted target_name and host_alias only.
Adoption imports could create services and environments without org_id ownership when invoked outside tenant-scoped routes.
No adopted_runtime_identity table existed for durable workload fingerprints.
intended_behavior: Persist stable adopted runtime fingerprints for container ID, image digest, Compose coordinates, and endpoint target references.
Surface endpoint identity input from Docker discovery responses without leaking managed Docker hosts.
Resolve adoption import ownership from an explicit org_id, an existing target environment org, or exactly one configured organization; otherwise fail closed.
Mark pre-existing unresolved service/environment ownership rows for operator repair during migration.
